title: Excellent guided walking tour with knowledgeable and entertaining guides
text: I participated in two tours, the Gaudi tour with Noah in the morning and the Gothic quarter tour with Elena in the evening. Both were excellent. I did not really get Gaudi’s art before but through Noah’s in-depth knowledge I learned to appreciate it. And Elena had so many interesting stories to share, including book recommendations related to the places that she showed us. It was truly captivating!

title: Great experience!!!
text: Very interesting, our guide took the time to explain things to us and answer our questions. Full of little anecdotes throughout the tour, it was the best visit we did in Barcelona. We highly recommend Joshua for his great generosity and he is super friendly. As a bonus, a list created by him for practical info and restaurant discoveries, shopping, etc. thanks a lot!!!
author: Agnes_Y

title: Great Gaudi experience
text: We chose Runner Beans as the name jumped out when we searched, and booked in for a Gaudí walking tour in Barcelona.  Lisa was at the meeting point early and kindly welcomed us along with others.  The tour took in 4 Gaudi buildings, but Lisa’s knowledge was extensive about his life, works and Barcelona architectural history.  Lisa was not only a guide for this tour, but also did everything she could to help us make the most of our stay in this gorgeous city.  I would definitely recommend joining a Runner Beans tour.

title: Runner Bean- fantastic tour!!
